# TeamStation URL Shortener

TeamStation URL Shortener creates branded short links and redirects them through Polr.

## Human UI

- Home page: `/`
- Paste a long TeamStation URL, submit, copy the generated short URL.

## Programmatic API

Endpoint:

```http
POST /api/shorten
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "url": "https://teamstation.us/example"
}
```

Response:

```json
{
  "shortUrl": "https://your-short-domain/abc123",
  "longUrl": "https://teamstation.us/example"
}
```

GET is also supported:

```http
GET /api/shorten?url=https%3A%2F%2Fteamstation.us%2Fexample
```

Optional fields:

- `customEnding`: custom slug ending, letters, numbers, dash, and underscore only.
- `secret`: boolean. When true, Polr creates a secret short URL variant.

Errors return JSON with an `error` field and appropriate HTTP status.
